articles.title: Macquarie Eyes Re Sustainability Deal And Expands Green Infrastructure Story
articles.mainIdea: Macquarie Eyes Re Sustainability Deal And Expands Green Infrastructure Story
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Macquarie Eyes Re Sustainability Deal And Expands Green Infrastructure Story. Macquarie Group (ASX:MQG) has reportedly shown early interest in joining the sale process for KKR backed Re Sustainability Limited. The potential sale involves one of India’s major waste management businesses, with several global investment firms exploring consortium bids. The process is at a preliminary stage, with discussions focused on forming bidding groups for the transaction.
